questions: How many vortices, islands and samples did you take spectra on, and how many showed the zero-bias peak? Your abstract says "MZMs are observed in all measured vortices", and the number behind "all" would help a reader a lot.
Were any vortices, islands or regions set aside (for example vortices near defects or island edges), and why?
Which ranges of field, temperature and tunnelling setpoint did you measure beyond the spectra shown at 0 T and 1.0 T, 0.4 K, 500 pA and 1 nA? Which fields do Figs. 4B-D correspond to?

What does the second-best vortex look like? Line cuts of spectra through the vortices in Figs. 4B-D would show whether each one carries the zero-bias peak, and it would help to know whether Figs. 2 and 3 show the same vortex.
Was the 0 T spectrum in Fig. 2I taken at the same spot as the 1.0 T vortex-core spectrum, and does the zero-bias peak move with the vortex when the field changes?

With an energy resolution of about 0.37 meV and a level spacing of about 0.7 meV, how well does a half-odd-integer sequence (lowest levels near ±0.35 meV) fit the peak positions in Fig. 3G, compared with the integer sequence?
Which data show the vortex number tuned by island size, and which island sizes did you measure?
Does the zero-bias peak height hold as you change the tip-sample coupling, as Zhu et al. did for vortex zero modes in FeTe0.55Se0.45?
